**2 — Vessel:** A large, shallow square dinner plate, partly cropped. I estimate its usable area as equivalent to a **28 cm diameter** round plate: 3.14 × 14² ≈ **615 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Ham-and-pineapple pizza with cheese, tomato sauce, and red onion; plain cooked chicken; loose pineapple; dark olives; cherry tomatoes. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible. Pizza toppings are included in the pizza estimate.

Area coverage totals **97%**, consistent with the nearly full plate. Bulk density is the only adjustment applied to gross volume.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **787 g and 1,420 kcal** is plausible for this heavily loaded plate, with most energy coming from the pizza and chicken. Plate size and pizza thickness are the largest uncertainties.
